name: civic-compass
description: Ideology-neutral civic decision-support (build -> ground -> analyze). /build-charter runs a Socratic interview that produces your CHARTER.md (ranked values + a decision rule + hard disqualifiers). /ground-charter validates it against your own writing/social export, with dated citations. /analyze-ballot deep-researches any ballot, applies your charter with cited reasoning, and writes a VOTING-GUIDE.md. It supplies the method, never the values.
